attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Array of Vendor objects to create in bulk

attributes.name: ReferenceId
attributes.description: Transient unique ID assigned by the developer. Used to reference individual vendors in the bulk-creation of vendors.

attributes.name: IsCompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the vendor identifies as a company

attributes.name: UseCompanyNameAsTaxpayerName
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not to use the company name for tax paying purposes

attributes.name: TaxpayerName
attributes.description: The taxpayer name of the vendor. If UseCompanyNameAsTaxpayerName is true, then TaxpayerName will be CompanyName. If IsCompany is true, and TaxpayerName is not provided, then TaxpayerName will be set to CompanyName. If IsCompany is false, and TaxpayerName is not provided, then TaxpayerName will be set to the concatenation of FirstName and LastName. If TaxpayerName is provided, and UseCompanyNameAsTaxpayerName is false, then TaxpayerName will be set as provided value.

attributes.name: TaxpayerId
attributes.description: The tax identification number of the vendor. This field accepts either a Employer Identification Number (EIN), a Social Security Number (SSN), or an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN).

attributes.name: CompanyName
attributes.description: The display name of a vendor's company. If IsCompany is true, this field is required.

attributes.name: Send1099
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the vendor needs a 1099 tax form from the management company

attributes.name: FirstName
attributes.description: The vendor's first name. If IsCompany is false, this field is required.

attributes.name: LastName
attributes.description: The vendor's last name. If IsCompany is false, this field is required.

attributes.name: Address1
attributes.description: The primary street address of the vendor. If provided, City and CountryCode must also be provided. A primary address is required when UseOnlinePayables is true.

attributes.name: Address2
attributes.description: Additional street information pertaining to the vendor. If provided, Address1, City and CountryCode must also be provided.

attributes.name: City
attributes.description: The city where the vendor is located. If provided, Address1 and CountryCode must also be provided. This attribute is required when UseOnlinePayables is true.

attributes.name: State
attributes.description: The state where the vendor is located (e.g. "CA" for California). If provided, Address1, City and CountryCode must also be provided. This attribute is required when UseOnlinePayables is true. This value must not be an unincorporated US territory (AS, FM, MH, MP, or VI) for primary address when UseOnlinePayables and VendorPaidByACH are both true.

attributes.name: Zip
attributes.description: The zip code where the vendor is located. Must be a valid 5-digit ZIP code (e.g., 93013) or ZIP+4 format (e.g., 93013-0429). If provided, Address1, City and CountryCode must also be provided. This attribute is required for primary address when UseOnlinePayables is true.

attributes.name: CountryCode
attributes.description: The country code of the vendor (e.g. "US" for United States). If provided, Address1 and City must also be provided. This attribute is required when UseOnlinePayables is true. This value must be "US" for primary address when UseOnlinePayables and VendorPaidByAch are both true.

attributes.name: PhoneNumbers
attributes.description: The vendor's phone number(s)

attributes.name: Number
attributes.description: The vendor's phone number

attributes.name: AdditionalDetails
attributes.description: Additional detailed information pertaining to the phone number

attributes.name: IsPrimary
attributes.description: Indicates whether the phone number provided is the vendor's main contact number

attributes.name: Label
attributes.description: The label of the phone number

attributes.name: Emails
attributes.description: The vendor's email address(es)

attributes.name: EmailAddress
attributes.description: The vendor's email address

attributes.name: IsPrimary
attributes.description: Indicates whether the email address provided is the vendor's primary email address

attributes.name: CompanyURL
attributes.description: The internet address of the vendor's website

attributes.name: LiabilityInsuranceExpiration
attributes.description: The expiration date of the vendor's liability insurance

attributes.name: AutoInsuranceExpiration
attributes.description: The expiration date of the vendor's automobile insurance

attributes.name: WorkersCompExpiration
attributes.description: The expiration date of the vendor's worker's compensation insurance

attributes.name: ContractExpiration
attributes.description: The expiration date of the contract

attributes.name: UmbrellaInsuranceExpiration
attributes.description: The expiration date of the vendor's umbrella insurance

attributes.name: CompliantStatus
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the vendor meets compliance

attributes.name: NetVendorId
attributes.description: The vendor's NetVendor ID

attributes.name: PaymentTerms
attributes.description: Represents the number of days the payment is due after the invoice date. A null value indicates that no payment terms were defined. A value of 0 indicates the payment is due on receipt. Required value of 1-31 if UsingEomTerms is true.

attributes.name: UsingEomTerms
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the payment terms include an end-of-month (EOM) stipulation. If a null value passed to UsingEomTerms or no value is provided, UsingEomTerms will default to false.

attributes.name: DefaultAutoAcceptWorkOrders
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is ineligible for auto-accept work order assignments. When set to true, this vendor will auto-accept all work orders assigned to them.

attributes.name: Tags
attributes.description: User-defined tag(s) that categorize the vendor

attributes.name: VendorPaidByACH
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the vendor is paid via ACH (Automated Clearing House) transfer.

attributes.name: UseOnlinePayables
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the vendor uses Online Payables for receiving payments.

attributes.name: BankAccountRoutingNumber
attributes.description: The vendor's bank account routing number. Must be a valid 9-digit ABA routing number. This attribute is required when both UseOnlinePayables and VendorPaidByACH are true. Will be ignored if online payables is enabled and vendor is not paid by ACH.

attributes.name: BankAccountNumber
attributes.description: The vendor's bank account number. Must be 4-17 characters and can only contain numbers and hyphens. This attribute is required when both UseOnlinePayables and VendorPaidByACH are true. Will be ignored if online payables is enabled and vendor is not paid by ACH.

attributes.name: SavingsAccount
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the bank account is a savings account. If false or not provided, the account is assumed to be a checking account. Will be ignored if online payables is enabled and vendor is not paid by ACH.

responseFields.name: JobId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the asynchronous bulk create job
